nodes.label: Tests for JSON decode failure fallback path (previously 0% covered).
When the LLM returns garbage, derive a readable name from the command instead…
Partial/truncated JSON also derives a name rather than falling back.
If the LLM echoes the schema placeholder as the name, derive a real one.
A genuine LLM-supplied name is kept as-is (not overridden by derivation).
LLM sometimes wraps JSON in markdown code fences — must be stripped.
JSON missing optional fields should use MetaAgentConfig defaults.
Full JSON response maps to MetaAgentConfig correctly.
Connector objects from the LLM should not be stringified into agent IDs.
interval_seconds value should be coerced to int.
The planner must pass system + user messages to the provider.
The planner must not force a Claude model onto OpenAI-compatible providers.
Slow provider calls should not block NL agent creation indefinitely.
Empty JSON {} should produce an agent with all defaults.
